answer: Sybil resistance comes from quadratic staking: every agent identity must lock collateral, and the required bond grows with the square of how many identities one funder controls. An attacker who splits capital across a thousand clones watches profit collapse toward its nadir, because payouts scale linearly while the bond cost is quadratic. Random audits sample the ocean of accounts and slash any pair caught sharing a funding key, and the forfeited stake replenishes an oasis of rewards for honest, uniquely attested agents.
